Redesign the Email Settings section in `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.settings.tsx`.

## Current state
There are 2 separate cards:
1. "Waitlist Notifications" — has notification email field + "Send Test Email" button
2. "Email Sender Settings" — has sender name, reply-to, and a small text preview

## What the user wants
Merge these 2 cards into a **side-by-side layout** using `Layout.Section.OneHalf`:
- **Left card**: All email settings (notification email, sender name, reply-to, send test email button) with clear labels and help text
- **Right card**: A real-time preview showing exactly how the email will look to customers (like a mini email preview mockup)

## Design requirements
1. Use `Layout.Section` with two `Layout.Section.OneHalf` children for side-by-side layout
2. Left card: "Email Settings" — combine all email fields with clear, simple language
   - Notification email: "Where should we notify you?" 
   - Sender name: Show shopName as placeholder, explain clearly
   - Reply-to email: explain what happens when customer hits reply
   - Send Test Email button at the bottom
3. Right card: "Email Preview" — show a realistic email preview that updates in real-time as the user types
   - Show a mock email with From, Reply-To, Subject, and body preview
   - Use Polaris `Box` with subtle background to make it look like an email client
   - Update dynamically based on the left-side field values
4. Use ONLY Polaris v13 components
5. Keep all existing functionality (fetchers, save logic, test email) working exactly the same
6. Remove the old separate "Waitlist Notifications" and "Email Sender Settings" sections

## Important
- Read the FULL current file first to understand all the state, fetchers, and handlers
- The `shopName` variable is available from `useLoaderData` — use it as the default sender name display
- Keep the `isDirty` tracking working correctly
- Keep all save/discard logic intact
- Run `npm run typecheck` after changes to verify 0 errors

## Reference
Read the current file at: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.settings.tsx`
